samplingConvention: Source-image-traced interior contours sampled at tissue centres on the existing 0.5 mm grid. Approximate teaching boundary permits edge partial volume; no all-27 containment requirement, no connectivity filling. The new right posterior portion remains separated from the old right body/columns.

limitation: Fornix remains partial: bilateral crural/posterior interiors, body and upper columns. The right posterior portion is separate; full fimbria and mammillary continuity remain unrecorded. Boundaries are approximate. Not expert-reviewed.

primaryReview.rationale: Existing same-specimen native100 contours were reused with teaching-scale centre sampling. Fourteen current voxel-footprint views (eight coronal, four sagittal, two horizontal) were reviewed against raw images. Existing ventricular cells, five uncertain bright puncta/edge cells and five tiny scope-edge pieces were held. No gap filling or claim of complete right continuity; partial-volume edges are allowed, not exact microscopic boundaries.
